question: Who became the new CEO of OLIPOP in August 2026?

hits.title: Olipop, the US gut health soda brand, has unveiled a leadership change as it prepares for its next stage of its growth.
hits.snippet: In a Linkedin announcement the company said that Olipop continues to grow in "scale, complexity, and reach" with the appointment of Webb, who has previously worked at Unilever and most recently for Electrolit, the hydration beverage brand, as CEO "marking an important moment in this evolution."

hits.title: Olipop taps Electrolit head as next CEO.
hits.snippet: Last year, Olipop reached a $1.85 billion valuation following a funding round led by Growth Equity Partners.

hits.title: Olipop prepares for growth with new CEO.
hits.snippet: OAKLAND, CALIF. - Functional soda company Olipop has named Christian Patiño Webb as its new chief executive officer to support its next stage of growth.

hits.title: OLIPOP, Space Camp Wellness collab on soda-inspired lip balms.
hits.snippet: Beauty brand Space Camp Wellness recently collaborated with OLIPOP for a set of four soda-inspired lip balms: Cream Soda, Vintage Cola, Shirley Temple and Crisp Apple.

hits.title: Olipop debuts nostalgic summer soda flavors with low sugar.
hits.snippet: Olipop has introduced two new summer sodas - Raspberry Sherbet (a limited-edition) and Blackberry Vanilla (now a permanent flavor) - both featuring 2-5 g of sugar and 6 g of fiber per can, and is celebrating with a Berry Sipport Center giveaway for fans to win cases of the drinks.
